text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — FosterHealth usage down ~48% week-over-week, renewal in 28 days. Main contacts changed (CTO replaced, new PM). Saw a competitive PoC mention in their notes. Can we triage? :eyes:
jon_se: ack. do we have event-level metrics? latency or errors spiked?
sam_ae: i talked to their champion yesterday — they mentioned 'NimbusAI' is running a side-by-side trial focused on response speed and cost. champion worried about token price and tail latency on long prompts.
maria_cs: no big error spikes in SLO pages, just sustained drop in query volume. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/fosterhealth/usage (internal link)
jon_se: can you paste the top 3 routes they're hitting? also any model changes pinned on their account?
maria_cs: top routes = /chat/assist, /embeddings/search, /rerank. Model pinned to redwood-3b-std last 2 months.
jon_se: okay — that model gets slower on sequences >2048 unless quantized. sending quick query to logs:```SELECT route, count(*) FROM requests WHERE customer='fosterhealth' AND ts > now()-7d GROUP BY route ORDER BY count DESC;```
fiona_bot: Reminder: Renewal flag set to 'at-risk' in CRM after last call.
sam_ae: i can swing an executive sync with them next week. we should prepare: 1) perf compare (latency distribution), 2) cost per 1k tokens at current config, 3) quick checklist for short-term wins (batching tweaks, prefix cache).
maria_cs: agreed. jon, can you own perf compare? sam, lead exec sync. i'll draft re-engagement email + enablement invite.
jon_se: will pull latency histograms and tail p99 for last 30 days. hypothesis: change in request mix -> longer conversations -> p99 up. i'll also check if we've auto-fallen back to a slower variant during maintenance windows.
maria_cs: also capture recent feature requests — they wanted tool-calling and structured outputs; maybe Nimbus is promising a turnkey integration. Capture that in notes.
sam_ae: putting tentative exec call on their calendar Tues 11am PT. sending invite now.
deploy_bot: Deploy #rwd/infra/4691 completed: kernel-opt patch rolled out 2026-03-11 02:14 UTC — no customer-impact alerts.
maria_cs: action items: jon -> perf report + config suggestions by EOD tomorrow, sam -> prep exec slides + cost matchup, me -> email + invite + capture stakeholder map. fiona_bot, mark follow-up in CRM 3/12. :thumbsup:
fiona_bot: Done — follow-up task created and assignee set to maria_cs.
sam_ae: one more — consider offering a 30-day trial extension or engineering office hours to keep them from switching. thoughts? :thinking:
jon_se: technically fine. but let's have the perf numbers before offering credits. might propose targeted engineering hours to optimize their routes first.
maria_cs: cool. i'll include that as an option in the exec deck. tagging @here for visibility — any objections?
